svg.title: InferRSI 知识库架构
svg.desc: Canonical sources feed source-pinned generated projections and explicit read/write authorities. Legacy search, default Collect and optional lexical selection/context remain separate. Exact-revision reads return complete required resources; the agent decides authorized use. Frozen evidence and reviewed matrices retain their ownership.
